# health-check
> Health check registry with timeout per check, critical flag, and express handler

Health check registry with per-check timeout, critical vs. non-critical failures, and express-style handler. Runs checks concurrently, produces detailed report with latencies, and calculates overall status (healthy/degraded/unhealthy).

## API
- `HealthStatus`
- `CheckResult`
- `CheckConfig`
- `HealthCheckFn`
- `CheckStatus`
- `HealthReport`
- `ExpressHandler`
- `HealthCheckRegistry`

## Install
Each library is a standalone GitHub repo under github.com/Ruzylo-cloud.

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/Ruzylo-cloud/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
